question: 2013 年佣金率是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) / SUM(fact_trades.Quantity * fact_trades.TradePrice) AS commission_rate FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金率 = 佣金合计 / 成交金额，无单位比率（口径以 YAML 表达式为准，派生指标锚定）
